artworks.title: Buffalo Chase, Sioux Indians, Upper Missouri
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated viewpoint of a scene with a Native American rider on horseback chasing a buffalo. The background features more buffalo and riders across grasslands under a blue sky with white clouds. The color palette is dominated by earthy tones.

artworks.title: After the Buffalo Chase - Sioux
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: A Sioux Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts a wide view from a slightly elevated perspective, showing a scene of daily life. The horizon is high in the image, where green hills meet the sky. The sky is painted with soft brushstrokes in blue, pink, and orange hues. The grassy plains in the forefront and background have figures, tepees, people, and horses engaged in various activities. The oval frame contains the composition. The color palette is natural and earthy, dominated by greens and browns, with pastel hues in the sky.

artworks.title: Halsey's Bluff - Sioux Indians on the March
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a peaceful landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon divides the sky from the land below, with distant blue hills visible. The sky shows soft blues and gray clouds. The brushwork is smooth and creates a serene atmosphere. The color palette includes earthy greens, browns, and distant cooler tones. A group of people on horseback carrying goods moves along a path. The scene suggests movement and continuity towards the rolling hills in the distance.

artworks.title: Sioux Village - Lac du Cygne
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a wide expanse of land with a line of trees, rolling hills, tipis, figures in canoes on a river or lake, and people gathered around the tipis. The brushstrokes are smooth and meticulous, capturing details in the landscape and structures. The color palette is warm and tranquil, with shades of light yellow, green, and brown dominating the land, transitioning into the orange and pink tones of the sky. The sky features a few wispy clouds.

artworks.title: A Sioux War Party
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon line, featuring trees and tent-like structures. The sky above transitions from warm oranges and yellows to darker clouds. The land has various green and brown hues, with small clusters of trees. In the distance, a body of water reflects the sky, and a canoe is visible. The overall color palette includes earthy tones in the land and vivid colors in the sky.

artworks.title: Bivouac of a Sioux War Party
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a forest scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is low in the composition, blocked by tall trees and dense foliage. To the left, a dark body of water can be seen. Fine brushstrokes capture intricate details of the trees and landscape with precision. The color palette is dark, with deep blues and greens, and a warm glow coming from a light source among the trees to the right. Figures are gathered around the light source, creating a focal point. The scene conveys a serene and mysterious forest setting, possibly at night or during twilight.

artworks.title: Amusing Dance - Sioux
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of Indigenous people engaged in a dance ritual. The figures are adorned in traditional attire, including feathers and body paint, and are arranged in a circular formation. Some figures hold objects resembling musical instruments or ceremonial items. The ground is covered with a light green grass texture, and the sky above is depicted in serene shades of blue with light clouds. The style is reminiscent of George Catlin, known for his paintings of Native American life. The artwork is encased in a painted oval border.

artworks.title: Bivouac of a Sioux War Party at Sunrise
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This painting depicts a wide, elevated view of a landscape with figures and animals in the foreground, leading toward a horizon with hills and trees. The sky above shows dynamic, swirling clouds. The brushstrokes are soft yet detailed, creating movement in the scene. The color palette includes warm earth tones like brown, green, and gold, giving the impression of evening or late afternoon. The figures and animals blend naturally with their surroundings.

artworks.title: Crow Chief, His Wife, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals in full-body view, standing side by side. The person on the left is leaning on their left leg, dressed in attire with fringes, long hair, a feathered headdress, holding a bow and shield. The central figure stands upright, wearing a feather headdress, a decorated garment with animal motifs, and holding a staff with feathers. The person on the right stands with folded arms, wearing a wrapped garment and holding a fan-like object. The background has soft, muted colors.

artworks.title: Distinguished Crow Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This painting shows a group of seven people standing closely. The people all have light brown skin and long black hair. On the far left appears to be a child with their back to us, holding a thin bow and arrow. On the far right is a slightly shorter figure than the other adults, perhaps a woman, holding a small dog or similar animal in her arms. The five people in the center are all of similar heights, and they all wear similar clothing with some slight differences. They are draped with tan fabric with uneven edges and some sections of brown fur over long tan pants. Their tan garments are adorned with colorful decorations that include geometric shapes and the outlines of people and animals. Some have feathers in their long hair or on their clothing, and some hold animal pelts. The skin on their faces, torsos, and arms is painted with red and black lines, and they are all adorned with jewelry, including several strands of necklaces, multiple earrings, and thick bracelets. The person second from the right is dressed in the most decorated clothing, which includes illustrations of people on horseback. They also have the longest hair, and a large bird that looks like an eagle is perched on their back behind their head. The ground is painted in soft lines of pale green and yellow, and the sky is light blue with pale gray and pink clouds. The painting is contained in a gray and black oval outline, beyond which is beige paper surrounded by a pale green border.

artworks.title: A Crow Chief, a Warrior, and His Wife
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing in a row. The person on the left holds a spear upright in their right hand, has long dark hair adorned with feathers, and wears a decorated garment. The central figure wears a headdress with feathers, a fringed tunic with circular decorations, and moccasins while holding a bow and arrows. The person on the right stands with their body slightly turned to the side, hands folded in front, dressed in a lengthy garment with a patterned shawl and their hair tied back. The background features a soft, cloudy sky with faint imagery of distant mountains and grassy ground. The painting is framed with an oval shape set within a larger green frame.

artworks.title: A Crow Chief at His Toilette
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a tipi in a grassy field, with Native American figures nearby engaging in daily activities. The scene includes horses grazing in the background and a serene sky with wispy clouds. The color palette consists of earthy tones and gentle blues.

artworks.title: Crow Warriors Bathing
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image features a circular frame showing a beach scene. In the foreground, people are on the sandy shore near a serene lake. Some are sitting or reclining on the bank, while others are in the water. There is sparse greenery leading to teepees in the distance, and mountains and clouds are visible in the sky. The painting has smooth brushstrokes conveying tranquility, with a color palette dominated by earthy tones, greens, and blues.

artworks.title: A Crow Village on the Salmon River
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a village of teepees spread out on a plain. In the foreground, a cluster of large teepees is surrounded by people engaged in various activities. More tents are scattered across the landscape. In the background, hills are visible before the horizon, and the sky displays a blend of sunset colors transitioning into cooler tones.

artworks.title: A Crow Village and the Salmon River Mountains
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a settlement surrounded by lush greenery and mountains in the distance. The mountains are partly covered by clouds. The painting technique is smooth and gentle, giving the scene a serene atmosphere. The color palette consists mainly of greens, browns, and blues. A row of traditional structures and small figures can be seen close to the viewer, while dense foliage transitions into hills and leads to the mountains in the background.

artworks.title: A Small Crow Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with blue-green mountains, a riverbank with a path, teepee structures in a grassland, and small human figures. The sky has pastel blue and pink tones, and the color palette is dominated by greens, blues, and earth tones. The brushstrokes are smooth and deliberate.

artworks.title: Two Blackfoot Warriors and a Woman
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing on a grassy terrain. The person on the left has dark hair and wears a pink garment with white and green details, arms crossed. In the center, an individual holds a long pole, wearing a detailed outfit with a circular pattern on the chest and feathered headwear. The person on the right holds a bow, also wearing feathered headwear and a decorated garment. The background depicts a simple illustration of sky and grass in beige, blue, and green hues.

artworks.title: A Blackfoot Chief, His Wife, and a Medicine Man
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in traditional clothing and accessories. Two adults are seated in the center, one adult is standing to the left holding a spear and shield, and one child is standing to the right holding a bow and quiver. The setting includes an open landscape and clouds in the background. The image is framed within an oval on a beige border.

artworks.title: Three Blackfoot Men
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in traditional attire. One person is sitting on the ground, facing forward with their knees drawn up, while the other two stand side by side, facing each other. The seated person has medium-length dark hair with decorative feathers, while the standing individuals have similar hair adorned with feathers and one with an animal hide draped over their shoulder. They all wear finely decorated cloaks over their shoulders, featuring intricate designs in soft earth tones, and one has a sun design with vibrant colors. The setting appears to be a grassy field with trees in the background under a blue sky with light clouds.

artworks.title: Arapaho Chief, His Wife, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: There are three figures depicted in the image. The figure on the left is a male standing upright, holding a rifle with one hand. His facial features show prominent cheekbones and a slightly open mouth. He wears a headdress with feathers, dark hair, a necklace, arm bands, and a fringed garment around his waist. The middle figure, with their back to the viewer, is wrapped in a fur clothing piece and appears to wear a feathered headdress. The figure on the right is a female with long dark hair, wearing a pink shawl over a light dress with patterns. She carries an infant on her back in a woven basket. The background shows a simple landscape with grassy terrain, a light blue sky with clouds, enclosed in an oval frame bordered further.

artworks.title: Two Arapaho Warriors and a Woman
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals depicted from head to toe. The person on the left is standing upright with their arms crossed in front of their chest and their head slightly bowed. They have long dark hair tied back and wear a knee-length garment. The central figure is seated on what appears to be a rock, holding a spear vertically in their right hand. Their face is partially obscured, and they also have long dark hair. The person on the right stands upright, holding a spear in their right hand, with long dark hair adorned with feathers. This individual wears a garment covering the waist and thighs, and their torso is bare. The background is plain with subtle earthy tones and softly brushed vegetation around the feet of the figures.

artworks.title: Assinneboine Warrior and His Family
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals. The adult male is standing at the center, wearing traditional clothing with feathers in his long black hair. He holds a fur piece. On his left, an adult female stands holding a child's hand. The child wears minimal clothing. On the right side of the male, two young individuals stand facing each other. They wear tunics with fringes. The background shows a light blue sky, green foliage, and brown ground. The scene is painted in an oval frame on a neutral-toned surface.

artworks.title: Assinneboine Chief before and after Civilization
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: A horizontal oval is divided vertically into two portraits to show the same brown-skinned man twice, once wearing Assiniboine tribal attire and once wearing a dark, military-style suit in this painting. In both portraits, the man has dark eyes and brows, high cheekbones, and a sloping nose. Straight black hair hangs around his face and down his back, and he wears red, blue, or white earrings from multiple piercings on his ear lobes. Both stand in landscapes with pale green trees and grass under ice-blue skies, and there are buildings in the distance of each. To our left, the man stands facing our left in profile, wearing tribal attire. There, his eyes are open wide, his lips are in a straight line, and there is a stripe of red along his lower jaw. The cascade of white and black feathers on his headdress disappears behind his lower back. He wears a tan leather tunic with leather leggings and beaded shoes. Medallions on his chest and a band down the sleeve and side of the pant leg we see are decorated in tones of tangerine orange, celery green, and harvest yellow. Fringe hangs from his sleeves and the front of his tunic. A sable-brown pelt or blanket hangs over his far shoulder and trails behind his feet, which are at the edge of a curving path leading into the distance. He holds a long pipe by his side in the hand we can see. In the distance behind him is a silvery-white domed building with rows of windows. A faint vertical line separates the man to our left from his counterpart to our right. There, he stands with his back to us with his face turned to our right in profile. His eyes are narrowed, and his lips are pursed around a cigarette. He wears an oyster-white top hat. His nearly knee-length black overcoat has gold epaulets on the shoulders and a gold-trimmed high collar. He has black pants, black shoes with pointed toes, and a wide red belt. Also around his waist, a leather band holds a curved gold sword hilt and scabbard so it hangs from long straps between his legs, the tip nearly brushing the ground. Dark glass bottles peek out of pockets on the back of his coat. In white-gloved hands, he holds up and gazes at a partially open saffron-orange fan in his right hand, and he holds a folded black umbrella in his other, leaning on it like a cane. In the landscape beyond him, several people stand in front of pale brown, cone-shaped tents. Brownish haze hangs over the horizon to our right. The oval is surrounded by borders of fawn brown and then black. The card paper on which this is painted is tawny brown around the oval. That paper is mounted on an olive-green paperboard. A slip of paper attached to the green board at the top center reads “83.” The lower left corner of the brown paper is inscribed in ink with an “A” over a dash, and then “126” below. In the green border below the portraits, the artist wrote a lowercase “a” to our left and “b” to our right.
